title: Psychedelic Crystal Sphere
description: A large glowing purple sphere sits atop a dark crystalline base with dripping magenta liquid. Inside the sphere stand a woman in an orange dress, a man in a green suit, and a woman in a blue dress, surrounded by branching pink lightning and floating bubbles. The background features turquoise starburst flowers and fireworks against a dark green backdrop.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a large transparent glowing purple sphere resting on a dark blue crystalline pedestal that drips vibrant magenta liquid. Inside the sphere are three people: a woman in an orange dress, a man in a green suit and tie, and a woman in a blue dress, all standing near bright pink electrical lightning branching from the center. Floating bubbles and molecular structures emerge from the top of the sphere while large turquoise starburst flowers and colorful fireworks explode in the dark green background.
